title: Research
text:
日本語English
研究テーマを、単なる手法の一覧ではなく「どの臨床的な問いに答えるか」を中心に整理しています。

title: Research
text:
Clinical epidemiology
日常診療で生じる問いを、対象集団、治療・曝露、比較、アウトカム、time zeroが明確な研究デザインへ変換します。観察データの強みを活かしながら、交絡、選択、測定、欠測によるバイアスを検討します。
代表論文

Classifying diarrhea in critically ill patients through various criteria: a cohort study — Journal of Intensive Care, 2025。重症患者の下痢を複数の基準で分類・評価。
Development and Initial Psychometric Validation of the COVID-19 Pandemic Burden Index for Healthcare Workers — Journal of General Internal Medicine, 2023。医療従事者の負担を測定する尺度の開発と初期検証。

title: Research
text:
Critical care outcomes
集中治療領域における短期転帰だけでなく、退院後の機能、生活の質、患者・家族にとって重要な長期転帰を扱います。競合イベントや追跡不能を含む、臨床的に意味のある解釈を重視します。
代表論文

Unraveling important outcomes for elderly patients facing critical illness: a vignette-based survey — Intensive Care Medicine, 2025。高齢者が重症疾患に直面した際に重視するアウトカムを調査。
Association between comorbidities at ICU admission and post-Sepsis physical impairment: A retrospective cohort study — Journal of Critical Care, 2024。ICU入室時の併存疾患と敗血症後の身体機能障害との関連を検討。

title: Research
text:
Causal inference
target trial emulation、傾向スコア、重み付け、時間依存性交絡などを用い、推定したい効果と解析上の仮定を対応させます。感度分析を、結果を増やすためではなく結論の頑健性を評価するために用います。
代表論文

Impact of an ROX index-guided intubation strategy on mortality in patients receiving high-flow nasal cannula: a target trial emulation — Journal of Intensive Care, 2026。ROX indexに基づく挿管方針をtarget trial emulationで評価。
Elderly Health Check-Up and Functional Disability or Death in Adults 75 to 84 Years: A Target Trial Emulation — Journal of the American Medical Directors Association, 2026。75〜84歳の健診受診方針と機能障害・死亡を評価。

title: Research
text:
AI bias, fairness, and transportability
医療AIに含まれるバイアスと患者集団間の公平性を研究しています。予測性能を識別能だけで判断せず、キャリブレーション、臨床的有用性、サブグループごとの性能、施設間移転性を含めて評価します。とくに、検査頻度など医療提供の過程で生じる「観察プロセス」が、予測と公平性に及ぼす影響に注目しています。
関連論文

Artificial Intelligence in Health Systems: Addressing Global Underperformance Through Digital Transformation — Annals of Clinical Epidemiology, 2026。医療システムにおけるAIとデジタルトランスフォーメーションを論じた論文。

text:

title: Research
text:
日本語English
My research is organized around clinical questions and the methods needed to answer them.

title: Research
text:
Clinical epidemiology
I translate questions from daily practice into study designs with explicit populations, treatments or exposures, comparators, outcomes, and time zero. I use observational data while examining confounding, selection, measurement, and missing-data biases.
Selected publications

Classifying diarrhea in critically ill patients through various criteria: a cohort study — Journal of Intensive Care, 2025. Classification and evaluation of diarrhea using multiple criteria in critically ill patients.
Development and Initial Psychometric Validation of the COVID-19 Pandemic Burden Index for Healthcare Workers — Journal of General Internal Medicine, 2023. Development and initial validation of a scale measuring the burden on healthcare workers.

title: Research
text:
Critical care outcomes
I study short-term outcomes in critical care as well as post-discharge function, quality of life, and long-term outcomes that matter to patients and families. Clinical interpretation accounts for competing events and loss to follow-up.
Selected publications

Unraveling important outcomes for elderly patients facing critical illness: a vignette-based survey — Intensive Care Medicine, 2025. A survey of outcomes valued by older adults facing critical illness.
Association between comorbidities at ICU admission and post-Sepsis physical impairment: A retrospective cohort study — Journal of Critical Care, 2024. Associations between comorbidities at ICU admission and physical impairment after sepsis.

title: Research
text:
Causal inference
I use target trial emulation, propensity scores, weighting, and approaches to time-varying confounding to align causal questions with analytic assumptions. Sensitivity analyses assess the robustness of conclusions.
Selected publications

Impact of an ROX index-guided intubation strategy on mortality in patients receiving high-flow nasal cannula: a target trial emulation — Journal of Intensive Care, 2026. Evaluation of an ROX index-guided intubation strategy using target trial emulation.
Elderly Health Check-Up and Functional Disability or Death in Adults 75 to 84 Years: A Target Trial Emulation — Journal of the American Medical Directors Association, 2026. Evaluation of health checkup strategies and disability or death among adults aged 75–84.

title: Research
text:
AI bias, fairness, and transportability
I study bias in medical AI and fairness across patient populations. Model evaluation includes calibration, clinical utility, subgroup performance, and transportability, alongside discrimination. I am particularly interested in how observation processes, such as testing frequency, influence prediction and fairness.
Related publication

Artificial Intelligence in Health Systems: Addressing Global Underperformance Through Digital Transformation — Annals of Clinical Epidemiology, 2026. A discussion of medical AI and digital transformation in health systems.

text:

Selected public tutorials with R code and worked examples for clinical research. These RPubs resources cover study design and applied analysis. The linked tutorials are primarily in Japanese.

title: Education
text:
Causal inference & survival analysis

Difference-in-differences (DiD) and event study
A brief introduction to DiD and event study concepts for readers new to these methods.


Time varying covariate in Cox regression
A tutorial on Cox regression with covariates that change over time, with a focus on immortal time bias and time-dependent analysis.

title: Education
text:
Clinical prediction models

Sample size calculation for clinical prediction model development
An introduction to sample size calculations using the R package pmsampsize, for researchers planning prediction model development.


Prediction model development and evaluation after multiple imputation
Missing-data imputation, model development, performance assessment, and validation with mice and psfmi, including how to pool results across imputed datasets.

title: Education
text:
Latent class analysis

Latent class analysis: from missing-data imputation to reporting results
Code examples using demonstration data, covering MissForest imputation, latent class analysis, fit indices, and the VLMR test.

These learning notes reflect the time at which they were written or updated. Check your R and package versions when using the code.

title: Education
text:
Causal inference & survival analysis

差分の差（DiD）とEvent Study
初めて学ぶ方向けの入門資料。DiDとEvent Studyの考え方を短時間で学びたいときに。


Time varying covariate in Cox regression
時間とともに変化する共変量を扱うCox回帰の学習資料。不死時間バイアスと時間依存性解析を考えるために。

title: Education
text:
Clinical prediction models

Clinical prediction model開発のためのサンプルサイズ計算
予測モデルの開発を計画する方向け。Rの pmsampsize を使ったサンプルサイズ計算を紹介します。


多重補完からの予測モデル作成と性能評価
mice と psfmi による欠測値の補完、予測モデルの開発、性能評価・検証を扱います。補完後の結果をどう統合するかを学びたいときに。

title: Education
text:
Latent class analysis

Latent class analysisの欠測補完から結果の提示
デモデータを用い、MissForestによる欠測補完から潜在クラス分析、適合指標・VLMR検定までを扱うコード例です。

各資料の作成・更新時点の学習ノートです。コードを利用する際は、使用するR・パッケージのバージョンもご確認ください。

title: Ryohei Yamamoto (Kobayashi)
text:
About
I am a board-certified specialist in emergency and intensive care medicine, hold a PhD in medicine, and am a certified expert of the Society for Clinical Epidemiology. Through study design, observational data analysis, and prediction model evaluation, I aim to clarify what findings mean, for whom, and under which conditions.
This website brings together my research, publications, open projects, and educational resources.

text:
About
救急科・集中治療の専門医、博士（医学）、日本臨床疫学会認定専門家です。臨床研究のデザイン、観察データ解析、予測モデル評価を通じて、結果の数字だけでなく「誰に、どの条件で、何を意味するか」を明確にすることを大切にしています。
このサイトでは、研究テーマ、論文、公開プロジェクト、教育資料をまとめています。
